decisions.contract: Product uses Agent Preset; runtime instance uses AgentSession.
FullAuto is the only execution behavior; no product approval modes.
NomiFun owns capability, session, preset, authority, credentials, and domain facts.
One Codex-derived sidecar runtime replaces Nomi while preserving complete Coding.
Ordinary first-party and third-party plugins are trusted in-process code.
Thin Functional Kernel is closed; all business domains are plugins.
Package, Capability, Skill, and MCP are the four product layers; Capability is executable.
Preset has initial and on-demand capability sets resolved once before Session creation.
The official preset key exact-set contains seven role presets.
Agent Preset uses one progressive editor; package, capability, skill, and MCP navigation remain separate.
First final-stack gate contains chat.minimal, coding.codex, and CI-only sample.echo.
v4 is a clean start with no legacy data conversion or compatibility read.
First v4 cutover performs one same-filesystem whole-root rename before creating an empty v4 root.
Every migration slice switches all direct consumers and deletes the replaced legacy surface in the same change.
Canonical semantic SessionEvent facts are authoritative; projections contain only UI state and never duplicate the Event Log.
Stable freezes a vendor-neutral seam; local install and one SDK begin only in Phase N1.
RemoteBinding selects an exact AgentBindingValue and uses explicit open, turn, observe, and cancel.
Lightweight Chat and complete Coding are structural conformance requirements, not a performance benchmark program.
Parallel work is enabled only for multi-task batches with disjoint writes and net speedup; no fixed agent count or EW estimate is a delivery contract.
Nomi is removed by one bounded C9 shutdown after the three release-blocking platform candidates; no sticky canary or durable handoff platform is required.
AgentSessionId UUIDv7 is the only product and execution session identity; Conversation is absent from v4.
Editor Test saves or reuses an ordinary revision, creates an ordinary persistent Session, and performs real FullAuto effects.
Official seeds are role-complete and context-minimal; G0 freezes their exact contribution manifest.
One irreversible delete closure uses the real Runtime dispose result, purges Session-owned content, and leaves only the four-field tombstone; callers provide no synthetic zero proof.
Compatibility compares only the frozen selected execution closure; incompatibility leaves the existing Session read-only and requires an explicit fork.
Remote token mutation atomically publishes generation and hash; requests authenticated before publication may finish, later old-token requests fail, and existing Sessions are not cascaded.
C9 performs one bounded shutdown, descendant-process cleanup, and explicit unknown handling before physical Nomi deletion; no online drain or exact-zero proof platform is required.
The release-blocking native platforms are Windows Desktop x64, macOS Desktop arm64, and Linux Desktop x64; additional targets are non-blocking engineering work.

closure_resolutions.canonical_rule: Markdown explains generated artifacts; Rust types, fresh-v4 schema, and SessionEvent Registry are the only machine owners.
Every digest artifact is payload plus envelope; payload digest excludes itself, status, evidence, logs, and summary.
Capability search and activation are internal Runtime control operations, not Capabilities and not initial selections.
capability/active-set-committed is the only persistent activation event; requested and failed are transient diagnostics.
Snapshot freezes only the selected capability, provider, tool, model, resource, and Runtime execution closure; actual build identity exists only in runtime/bound.
Manifest is the declaration source; registration metadata is derived from real handlers and services, and plugins receive only narrow declared context.
Once durable, the immutable parent marker survives mkdir or rename failure and is removed only after ready and metadata exact-match.
Fresh initialization order is schema and schema_metadata, bundled Package materialization, seven authoring seeds, ready, then marker removal.
Canonical errors are uppercase; missing catalog materialization is CAPABILITY_NOT_MATERIALIZED and outside-ceiling is CAPABILITY_NOT_IN_PRESET.
Stable promotes the exact signed RC artifact and signature envelope; any signed-envelope or content change is a new candidate.
Stable may edit schema-backed config of already mounted bundled Packages but provides no user install, lifecycle, SDK, or market.
